maddeler.e:
أتمارض (form VI)
# أَتَمَارَضُ (ʔatamāraḍu) /ʔa.ta.maː.ra.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
# أَتَمَارَضَ (ʔatamāraḍa) /ʔa.ta.maː.ra.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
# أَتَمَارَضْ (ʔatamāraḍ) /ʔa.ta.maː.radˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَارَضَ (tamāraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
